items.title: Sky Terrace Residences — 3 BHK

amenities: Power backup for lifts and common areas

items.short_description: A bright, east-facing 3 BHK on the ninth floor with a wide deck, modular kitchen and two covered parking spaces, in a gated tower with a full clubhouse.
items.description:
Sky Terrace Residences is a completed, OC-received tower of 18 floors on the quiet side of Baner. This three-bedroom home has a 14-ft living room that opens onto a deck overlooking the landscaped podium, a modular kitchen with a utility balcony and three attached bathrooms.

Highlights

  • Ready to move: occupancy certificate received
  • Semi-furnished: wardrobes, modular kitchen, lights and fans
  • Two covered car parks and a store room

Home-loan approved by leading banks. Registration and stamp duty are extra.

items.title: Aranya Villas — 4 BHK private pool villa
items.short_description: A contemporary four-bedroom villa with a private pool, double-height living room and a landscaped garden, in a gated enclave of 24 homes.
items.description:
Designed by an award-winning Pune studio, Aranya Villas are built on 5,000 sq ft plots with generous setbacks and lots of glass. Each villa has a double-height living room, a family lounge upstairs, a home office and a private pool deck.

Possession is planned for December 2027. A payment plan linked to construction stages is available.

items.title: Kerala-style bungalow with garden

amenities: Mature garden with coconut and mango trees

items.short_description: A calm, sloping-roof bungalow on a 4,800 sq ft plot with a wraparound verandah and a mature garden, fully furnished and ready to move in.
items.description: Rarely available in central Aundh: an independent bungalow on its own plot, built in 2014 with a traditional tiled roof, teak doors and a deep verandah. The house has three bedrooms, a puja room, a large dining hall and a covered parking for two cars.

items.title: Riverside Row Houses — 3 BHK
items.short_description: Three-storey row houses with a private terrace and garden near EON IT Park. Pre-launch prices for the first 20 homes.
items.description: A low-density community of 64 row houses along the river, with private front gardens, a terrace on every home and a shared riverside walkway.

items.title: Skyline Penthouse with private terrace
items.short_description: The top-floor penthouse of a 22-storey tower, with a 1,200 sq ft private terrace and views across the Hinjewadi hills.
items.description: A duplex penthouse with four bedrooms, a home theatre, a private lift lobby and a large terrace with a jacuzzi.

items.title: 2 BHK apartment for rent
items.short_description: A fully furnished 2 BHK with appliances, ideal for working professionals or a small family. Available from the 1st of next month.
items.description: Furnished with beds, sofa, dining table, refrigerator, washing machine, ACs in both bedrooms and a modular kitchen. Two months’ deposit; maintenance included.

items.title: Grade-A office floor, Business Park
items.short_description: A full, bare-shell office floor of 9,800 sq ft in a LEED-certified business park, with 12 car parks. Also available on lease.
items.description: Suitable for an IT or BFSI company: a column-free floor plate, raised floors, a 1:1,000 parking ratio and 24×7 security.

items.title: High-street retail showroom
items.short_description: A ground-floor showroom with a 40-ft glass frontage on one of Pune’s busiest shopping streets. Ideal for fashion or electronics brands.
items.description: Available on a 9-year lease with a 3-year lock-in.

items.title: Residential plot in a gated layout
items.short_description: A 2,400 sq ft NA-approved plot in a gated layout with roads, drainage and street lights already in place. Bank loans available.
items.description: Build your own home at your pace. Construction partners available on request.

items.title: Corner plot near the expressway
items.short_description: A 3,200 sq ft corner plot close to the Chakan industrial belt.
items.description: Suitable for a home or a small commercial building.

items.title: Garden villa — 3 BHK
items.short_description: A modern three-bedroom villa backing onto the Bavdhan hills, with a private garden and a terrace on the upper floor.
items.description: Spacious, light-filled rooms with large sliding windows and a covered car port.

data.heading: About Keystone Realty
data.subheading: Honest property advice in Pune since 2010.

data.heading: We would rather lose a deal than lose your trust
data.description:
Keystone Realty was founded by Aditya Deshmukh after a decade with a national developer. He saw buyers making the biggest purchase of their lives with little reliable information — so he started an advisory that puts the buyer first.

We are registered with MahaRERA, work with 45 reputed builders, and are a member of the local real-estate association.

data.heading: Questions buyers ask us
data.description: Can’t find your answer? Call us — we are happy to help.

items.question: Do you charge buyers a fee?
items.answer: For new projects from our builder partners there is no fee for buyers. For resale homes and rentals our fee is agreed in writing before the first site visit.

items.question: Are your listings verified?
items.answer: Yes. We visit every property, check the ownership documents and confirm RERA registration for projects before listing them.

items.question: Can you help NRIs buy property?
items.answer: Yes. Our NRI desk arranges video tours, legal checks, home loans for NRIs and registration through a power of attorney.

items.question: What extra costs should I budget for?
items.answer: In Maharashtra, plan for about 6% stamp duty, 1% registration (capped), GST on under-construction homes and society or maintenance deposits.

data.content:
This policy explains how Keystone Realty collects, uses and protects the personal information you share through this website.

Information we collect

When you send an enquiry or request a site visit we collect your name, phone number, email address and the details you provide, such as the property you are interested in.

How we use it

We use your details only to respond to your enquiry, arrange visits and share relevant properties. We do not sell your information. We may share it with the builder or owner of a property you ask about, only to arrange a visit.

Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete your information at any time by writing to the email address on our contact page.

By using this website you agree to these terms.

Listings

Property details, prices and availability are provided by owners and builders and may change without notice. Please verify all details before making a decision.

Fees

Where a brokerage fee applies, it is agreed in writing before any site visit.

Liability

Keystone Realty is not liable for decisions made only on the basis of information on this website.

The images on this website are illustrations and may not represent the actual property.

Prices exclude stamp duty, registration charges, GST and other statutory charges unless stated. RERA registration numbers are shown where applicable; buyers should verify them on the MahaRERA website.
